title: Shortest Path To Get Food
description:
A grid contains one start cell `*`, zero or more food cells `#`, open cells `O`, and obstacles `X`. Move up, down, left, or right through any non-obstacle cell. Return the fewest moves from the start to any food cell, or `-1` if none is reachable.

## Examples

```text
Input: grid = [["X","X","X","X","X","X"],["X","*","O","O","O","X"],["X","O","O","#","O","X"],["X","X","X","X","X","X"]]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: grid = [["X","X","X","X","X"],["X","*","X","O","X"],["X","O","X","#","X"],["X","X","X","X","X"]]
Output: -1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= grid.length, grid[i].length <= 200`
- Exactly one cell is `*`; all cells are one of `*`, `X`, `O`, `#`
